title: scPASU: A computational protocol for quantifying polyadenylation site usage from scRNA-seq data
author: Krylova, Le, et al.

steps.title: Open configuration directory
steps.instruction: Navigate to the scPASU configuration folder located at scPASU_snakemake_version/config.

steps.title: Edit dataset parameters in config.yaml
steps.instruction: Open config.yaml in a text editor and set the dataset‑specific variables:

substeps.instruction: compartment: set to the cell group prefix (e.g., "fibroblasts").
genomename: choose "hg38" for human or "mm10" for mouse.
chrs: list chromosomes (human example – "chr1,chr2,…,chrX,chrY").
samples: provide an array of sample names exactly matching Cell Ranger output (e.g., ["Sample_1", "Sample_2", "Sample_3"]).
subset: set to "true" to analyze a specific barcode list, otherwise "false".
PAS_filtering: set to "true" to run poly(A) site filtering, or "false" to skip.
group_one and group_two: specify the two cell groups for APA/DEG comparison (e.g., group_one: "Umbrella", group_two: "Basal").
meta_testing_column: name of the metadata column containing the group labels (e.g., "cell_type").

steps.title: Edit file path parameters in config.yaml
steps.instruction: Continue editing config.yaml and provide absolute or relative paths for all required files and tools:

substeps.instruction: work_dir: absolute path to the scPASU workflow directory (e.g., "/path/to/scPASU/workflow/").
cellrangeroutputpath: absolute path to the directory with Cell Ranger BAM outputs (e.g., "/path/to/cellranger/alignments").
cellrangerrefpath: absolute path to the genome reference used for Cell Ranger (e.g., "/path/to/cellranger/reference/").
barcodepath: relative path from the workflow directory to the folder with per‑sample barcode TSV files; leave empty "" if subset is false, otherwise e.g., "data/subset_bams".
seurat_obj_file: relative path to an optional Seurat object RDS file for barcode matching; leave "" if not used, otherwise e.g., "data/seurat_object_name.rds".
metadata_file: relative path to a CSV file with cell metadata (e.g., "data/metadata_file_name.csv").
polyAfilterpath: absolute path to the cloned polyAfilter package directory (e.g., "/path/to/package/polyAfilter/").
cellrangerpath: absolute path to the installed Cell Ranger software (e.g., "/path/to/package/cellranger/version_number/").
goldminepath: absolute path to the directory containing the goldmine R package library (e.g., "/path/to/R/package/library"); the library folder must contain the "goldmine" package directory.

steps.title: Execute module 5 via Snakemake
steps.instruction: Run the Snakemake command to launch Module 5, which merges count matrices, performs APA and DEG testing, and creates UCSC Genome Browser tracks:

substeps.instruction: snakemake run_module_5 --jobs [job_num] --cluster 'HPC_submit_parameters' --use-conda
Replace [job_num] with the desired number of parallel jobs and supply appropriate HPC submission parameters.

Note: Module 5 contains six rules – merge_per_sample_peakcounts, merge_per_sample_genecounts, APA_testing, DEG_testing, make_fractional_tracks, and make_track_annotations – which are executed automatically by the command.
